item.title: Accel reportedly in talks to lead $1B round for Thinking Machines at $40B valuation
item.description: The high-profile startup's annual revenue run rate stands at over $100 million.

item.title: Abliteration.ai is making a business out of removing AI guardrails
item.description: Abliteration.AI is making powerful AI models without guardrails easier to access, arguing that giving defenders the same tools as bad actors could ultimately improve cybersecurity.

item.title: Meta is paying to peek at how you use their latest AI model
item.description: For its new Muse Spark model, intended for operating coding and other agents, Meta is offering an explicit discount averaging out to about 95% for users who "contribute" to the development of future models by sharing their prompts and model outputs.

item.title: OpenAI launches Astra, its powerful (and controversial) new model
item.description: OpenAI claims that Astra represents "a new frontier on computer and browser use," and that it handles tasks with unmatched "speed, accuracy, and safety."

item.title: Ollie is betting its focus on privacy can help it win the AI assistant race
item.description: The family-focused AI assistant wants access to the details of your everyday life, but says it won’t use that data to train AI models or share it with others.

item.title: Google’s latest AI weather model gives you no excuse to forget your umbrella
item.description: WeatherNext 3 is the latest wave of a sea change in meteorology brought out by deep learning techniques. Google says it will start feeding into weather information users see in search, Google Maps, and Gemini.

item.title: Nvidia confirms it will buy Hugging Face for $12.9 billion
item.description: Nvidia said Hugging Face hosts over 3 million models and is used by over 18 million developers.

item.title: The Builders Stage brings practical strategies for scaling startups to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
item.description: The Builders Stage is returning to TechCrunch Disrupt, bringing together founders, startup operators, and investors for practical conversations on what it takes to build and scale.

item.title: Palo Alto Networks paid $500M for Thrive-backed Console, sources say
item.description: The acquisition also leaves Sequoia-backed Serval as the de facto startup leader in AI IT service automation, industry watchers believe.

item.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026’s new Real World AI Stage features Nvidia, robots, and extinct animals
item.description: On our new Real World AI stage, we’ll be focusing on the intersection between the digital and physical, and all the ways we’ll continue to see a blending of the two.

item.title: OpenAI’s new reasoning technique alarms AI safety experts
item.description: OpenAI’s new Astra model will use “recurrent depth,” a technique that allows the model to operate outside of the sequential thinking that characterizes most reasoning models.

item.title: US government sides with OpenAI on issue of training LLMs on copyrighted material
item.description: "The United States has a strong interest in continuing to develop a robust and competitive artificial intelligence industry that sets the standard for the practice and procedure of AI use globally," the brief reads.

item.title: Wonderful more than doubles its valuation to $5B in under 6 months
item.description: Wonderful said it will use its $550 million Series C funding to develop products faster, expand its FDE teams, and meet demand for its products.

item.title: India’s richest man now wants to turn aging computers into AI-ready PCs
item.description: Jio is betting it can turn an aging computer into an AI-ready PC for as little as about $11 for two months.

item.title: HiddenLayer nabs $100M as enterprises rush to secure their AI deployments
item.description: Security companies are scrambling to build products that can monitor not just agents but also the tools and add-ons they use.

item.title: PSA: Amazon’s shopping AI can now tell you if that message is a scam
item.description: Amazon is adding a scam-detection feature to Alexa for Shopping that can verify whether suspicious emails, texts, and other messages actually came from the retailer.

item.title: Adobe acquires Indian market intelligence startup Rilo
item.description: This is Adobe's second acquisition out of India after Rephrase.ai in 2023
